title: Host API calls time out (30 s) while the machine is CPU-saturated: mailbox read and acknowledge requests failed about 17:00Z on 2026-10-09
outcome: Under heavy CPU contention on the machine, the TermAl host's control API (mailbox read, acknowledge, send) stays responsive within its client timeout, or degrades with a typed, retryable answer rather than a silent 30 s transport timeout whose outcome is unknown.
acceptance: The holder's note identifies, with evidence, why mailbox read and acknowledge requests exceeded 30 s at about 17:00Z on 2026-10-09 (for example: runtime thread starvation, a lock held across slow I/O, or CPU saturation of the whole process), with file:line where the code is implicated.
A test or measured drill under induced CPU contention shows the chosen remedy: the API answers within its timeout, or returns a typed retryable error, and acknowledgements stay idempotent.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact committed tree.
